Actual repository status supplies modified, missing, staged-deleted, directory descendant and untracked rows. Default selects tracked changes, including missing; missing preference excludes worktree deletion but retains staged deletion. Automatic off leaves folder descendants unchecked, while explicit missing/untracked files override preferences. Refresh preserves manual selection. Old dialog retains captured settings; new dialogs read changed settings. Two-item message history trims oldest values in private domain. Real ReCommit commits only manually checked modified path, then enables automatic checking of remaining tracked rows without altering saved auto-off preference. Exact original index/config/HEAD/ref and extant working files preserved during read/selection phases. Settings hosted and laid out in an owned hidden window; no physical checkbox/stepper input or screenshot evidence.
